agent_explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity-error toward waypoint plus noise, but not clamped to fmax. In shrunk case kp=28.6, vcmd=4.4, distance to waypoint demands large velocity change from zero, so kp*error ≈105 N, exceeding declared fmax 81.18 N. Increasing fmax to 200 removes violation, confirming the limiter is missing/broken.
